author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: कामकारेण फलकामादिना कर्मानुष्ठानेन संन्यासाभावेनेति यावत् ।  फले क्षुद्रफले सक्तो निबध्यते नितरां संसारमनुभवतीत्यर्थः
translation: V. Abandoning......action : of course, abandoning also desire, wish, thought, &c., of the fruit, i.e., becoming a Sanyasin as explained above. Follow's Yoga: performs duties regarding them acts of worship of the Lord, Natural: essential. Peace: the essential blessedness to which the soul is restored. He.....desire: he who has not become a Sanyasin in the above sense, i.e., does not perform duties without motives or desires and simply for the Lord's grace. To the result: to the limited consequences of action, Is bound down : is subject to endless sufferings of birth and death
